items.source: target - the target registry to copy to
items.translation: target - 要复制到的目标注册表

items.source: This is expected to be a collaborator with PropertyEditorRegistrySupport, downcasting the given PropertyEditorRegistry accordingly and calling overrideDefaultEditor(Class, PropertyEditor) for registering additional default editors on it.
items.translation: 这预期是一个与 PropertyEditorRegistrySupport 协作的类，将给定的 PropertyEditorRegistry 相应地向下转换，并调用 overrideDefaultEditor(Class, PropertyEditor) 以在其上注册额外的默认编辑器。

items.source: Those editors are not registered by default simply because they are in general inappropriate for data binding purposes. Of course, you may register them individually in any case, through registerCustomEditor(Class, PropertyEditor).
items.translation: 这些编辑器默认未注册，主要是因为它们通常不适用于数据绑定目的。当然，在任何情况下，你都可以通过registerCustomEditor(Class, PropertyEditor)单独注册它们。

items.source: Called by findCustomEditor(Class, String) if no required type has been specified, to be able to find a type-specific editor even if just given a property path.
items.translation: 在调用 findCustomEditor(Class, String) 时，如果未指定必需类型，则能够仅根据属性路径找到特定类型的编辑器。

items.source:
Note that this is different from registering a custom editor in that the editor
semantically still is a default editor. A ConversionService will override such a
default editor, whereas custom editors usually override the ConversionService.
items.translation: 请注意，这与注册自定义编辑器不同，因为该编辑器在语义上仍然是一个默认编辑器。ConversionService 会覆盖此类默认编辑器，而自定义编辑器通常用于覆盖 ConversionService。

items.source: Lazily registers the default editors, if they are active.
items.translation: 懒加载注册默认编辑器（如果它们处于活动状态）。

items.source: Base implementation of the PropertyEditorRegistry interface. Provides management of default editors and custom editors. Mainly serves as base class for BeanWrapperImpl.
items.translation: `PropertyEditorRegistry` 接口的基实现。提供默认编辑器和自定义编辑器的管理功能。主要作为 `BeanWrapperImpl` 的基类使用。

items.translation: 指定一个用于转换属性值的 `ConversionService`，作为 JavaBeans PropertyEditors 的替代方案。

items.source: Activate config value editors which are only intended for configuration purposes, such as StringArrayPropertyEditor.
items.translation: 激活仅用于配置目的的配置文件编辑器，例如 StringArrayPropertyEditor。

items.source: Copy the custom editors registered in this instance to the given target registry.
items.translation: 将此实例中注册的自定义编辑器复制到指定的目标注册表中。

items.source: Copy the default editors registered in this instance to the given target registry.
items.translation: 将此实例中注册的默认编辑器复制到指定的目标注册表。

items.translation: 查找给定类型和属性的自定义属性编辑器。

items.source: Return the associated ConversionService, if any.
items.translation: 返回关联的 ConversionService（如果有）。

items.source:
Guess the property type of the specified property from the registered
custom editors (provided that they were registered for a specific type).
items.translation: 根据已注册的自定义编辑器（前提是它们是为特定类型注册的）猜测指定属性的属性类型。

items.source:
Determine whether this registry contains a custom editor
for the specified array/collection element.
items.translation: 确定此注册表是否包含针对指定数组/集合元素的自定义编辑器。

items.source: Register the given custom property editor for all properties of the given type.
items.translation: 为给定类型的所有属性注册给定的自定义属性编辑器。

items.source:
Activate the default editors for this registry instance,
allowing for lazily registering default editors when needed.
items.translation: 为此注册表实例激活默认编辑器，以便在需要时懒式注册默认编辑器。

items.source: elementType - the target type of the element (can be null if not known)
items.translation: elementType - 元素的目标类型（如果未知，可以是 null）

items.source: propertyPath - the property path (typically of the array/collection; can be null if not known)
items.translation: propertyPath - 属性路径（通常为数组/集合的属性；如果未知，可以是 null）

items.source: registrar - the registrar to call when default editors are actually needed
items.translation: registrar - 在真正需要默认编辑器时调用的注册表。

items.translation: requiredType - 属性的类型

items.translation: propertyEditor - 要注册的编辑器

items.translation: requiredType - 属性的类型

items.source: the default editor, or null if none found
items.translation: 默认编辑器，或者如果未找到则为null

items.source: the property type, or null if not determinable
items.translation: 属性类型，或如果无法确定则为null

items.source: nestedProperty - the nested property path of the target registry, if any. If this is non-null, only editors registered for a path below this nested property will be copied. If this is null, all editors will be copied.
items.translation: `nestedProperty` - 目标注册表的嵌套属性路径（如果有）。如果此值非空，则仅复制为此嵌套属性以下路径注册的编辑器。如果此值为 null，则复制所有编辑器。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Sebastien Deleuze
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Sebastien Deleuze

items.source: whether a matching custom editor has been found
items.translation: 是否已找到匹配的自定义编辑器

items.source: If the property path denotes an array or Collection property, the editor will get applied either to the array/Collection itself (the PropertyEditor has to create an array or Collection value) or to each element (the PropertyEditor has to create the element type), depending on the specified required type.
items.translation: 如果属性路径表示数组或集合属性，编辑器将应用于该数组/集合本身（`PropertyEditor 必须创建数组或集合值），或者应用于每个元素（`PropertyEditor` 必须创建元素类型），具体取决于指定的所需类型。

items.source: The default implementation always returns null. BeanWrapperImpl overrides this with the standard getPropertyType method as defined by the BeanWrapper interface.
items.translation: 默认实现始终返回null。 BeanWrapperImpl 使用 BeanWrapper 接口定义的标准的getPropertyType方法覆盖此行为。

items.source:
Note: Only one single registered custom editor per property path
is supported. In the case of a Collection/array, do not register an editor
for both the Collection/array and each element on the same property.
items.translation: 注意：每个属性路径仅支持注册一个自定义编辑器。对于集合/数组，请勿在同一属性上为集合/数组及其每个元素同时注册编辑器。

items.source:
For example, if you wanted to register an editor for "items[n].quantity"
(for all values n), you would use "items.quantity" as the value of the
'propertyPath' argument to this method.
items.translation: 例如，如果您想为"items[n].quantity"（所有 n 值）注册一个编辑器，您会将"items.quantity"用作此方法的`propertyPath`参数的值。

items.source: Retrieve the default editor for the given property type, if any.
items.translation: 获取给定属性类型的默认编辑器（如果有）。

items.source: Determine the property type for the given property path.
items.translation: 确定给定属性路径的属性类型。

items.source: Override the default editor for the specified type with the given property editor.
items.translation: 使用给定的属性编辑器覆盖指定类型的默认编辑器。

items.source:
Register the given custom property editor for the given type and
property, or for all properties of the given type.
items.translation: 为给定的类型和属性注册指定的自定义属性编辑器，或为该类型的全部属性注册。

items.source: Set a registrar for default editors, as a lazy way of overriding default editors.
items.translation: 为默认编辑器设置一个注册表，作为一种懒式覆盖默认编辑器的方法。

items.source: requiredType - the type of the property. This may be null if a property is given but should be specified in any case, in particular in case of a Collection - making clear whether the editor is supposed to apply to the entire Collection itself or to each of its entries. So as a general rule: Do not specify null here in case of a Collection/array!
items.translation: requiredType - 属性的类型。如果给出了属性，但必须指定（特别是在集合的情况下），则此值可能为 null，以明确编辑器是应用于整个集合本身还是其每个条目。因此，一般规则如下：对于集合/数组，请勿在此处指定 null！

items.source: propertyPath - the path of the property (name or nested path), or null if registering an editor for all properties of the given type
items.translation: propertyPath - 属性的路径（名称或嵌套路径），或者在注册给定类型的所有属性的编辑器时为 null。

items.source: requiredType - the type of the property (can be null if a property is given but should be specified in any case for consistency checking)
items.translation: requiredType - 属性的类型（如果已提供属性，该值可以为 null，但为了保持一致性检查，在任何情况下都应指定）

items.source: propertyPath - the path of the property (name or nested path), or null if looking for an editor for all properties of the given type
items.translation: propertyPath - 属性的路径（名称或嵌套路径），或者如果正在查找给定类型所有属性的编辑器，则为 null。

items.source: propertyEditor - editor to register
items.translation: propertyEditor - 要注册的编辑器

items.source: the registered editor, or null if none
items.translation: 已注册的编辑器，或者如果没有则返回null。

items.source: propertyPath - the property path to determine the type for
items.translation: propertyPath - 用于确定类型的属性路径

items.source: the type of the property, or null if not determinable
items.translation: 属性的类型，或者如果无法确定则为null。
